In chemistry, Percentage Composition tells you the percentage by mass of each element in a compound. It is the ratio of the mass of a specific element to the total mass of the entire molecule.

**The Formula:**
$$\text{Percentage Composition} = \left( \frac{\text{Mass of Element}}{\text{Total Mass of Compound}} \right) \times 100$$

**Example:**
Take Water ($H_2O$).
1. Find the molar mass: $H$ is $\approx 1$, $O$ is $\approx 16$. So, $H_2O = (2 \times 1) + 16 = 18 \text{ g/mol}$.
2. Find the mass of Hydrogen: $2 \text{ g}$.
3. Calculate: $(2 / 18) \times 100 = 11.1\%$.
